ideas.title: Uncovering the Scope of Healthcare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the $21 million Medicaid fraud scheme and other healthcare-related fraud cases in Minnesota to understand the scope and impact of such crimes.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and examine the individuals and organizations involved
questions: What are the implications for Minnesota's healthcare system?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal systemic issues within Minnesota's healthcare system and potentially lead to reforms

ideas.title: The Web of Large-Scale Fraud Schemes in Minnesota
ideas.description: Explore the $90 million fraud schemes involving 15 accused individuals and other similar cases to identify patterns and connections
ideas.angle: Data analysis and public records to identify entities and individuals involved
questions: What are the common factors among these schemes?
Are there larger organizations or networks involved?
How can these schemes be prevented in the future?
ideas.insight: This investigation could uncover a larger network of fraudulent activities and lead to significant policy changes
